statements.select_model/column_aliases.note: SELECT list must use model aliases (x, yr, s), not c, y.
statements.select_model/column_aliases.sql: SELECT x, yr, s FROM t MODEL PARTITION BY (c x) DIMENSION BY (y yr) MEASURES (amt s, 0 csum) RULES (csum[2024] = s[2024]);

statements.select_pivot_unpivot/pivot_xm.note: MODE is an Oracle reserved word; renamed pivot column to pm.
statements.select_pivot_unpivot/pivot_xm.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT XML (SUM(amt) FOR pm IN (ANY));

statements.select_pivot_unpivot/pivot_xm.note: MODE is an Oracle reserved word; renamed pivot column to pm.
statements.select_pivot_unpivot/pivot_xm.sql: SELECT * FROM t PIVOT XML (SUM(amt) FOR pm IN (SELECT DISTINCT pm FROM u));
